verdict.rationale: Bruno CLI is documented and hands-on verified to run collections headlessly (bruno-probe-4), supports JUnit/JSON/HTML reports for CI analysis (bruno-docs-2, bruno-docs-22), explicit CI/CD integration docs (bruno-docs-3), and official Docker images for pipeline use without needing Node/npm (bruno-docs-18). Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of build-failing exit codes on test regressions and real-world CI pipeline examples beyond vendor docs.
